Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). did_you_know.fact: On July 9, 2002: The African Union is established in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, replacing the Organisation of African Unity (OAU). The organization's first chairman is Thabo Mbeki, President of South Africa.

image_credit.author: African Union - supranational union in Africa

did_you_know.fact: On July 9, 1961: Greece becomes the first member state to join the European Economic Community by signing the Athens Agreement, which is later suspended in 1967 during the Greek junta.
On July 9, 1922: Johnny Weissmuller swims the 100 meters freestyle in 58.6 seconds, breaking the world swimming record and the 'minute barrier'.
July 9 is observed as Constitutionalist Revolution Day (São Paulo).
July 9 is observed as Arbor Day (Cambodia).
